cohort: Patients who delivered at SRVS Medical College, Shivpuri, India between April 1, 2022 and October 31, 2022 and were diagnosed with primary PPH (within 24 hours after delivery).
finding: The incidence of primary PPH was 5.55%, with previous LSCS and PIH as major risk factors, and uterine atony as the primary cause.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery in 56.7% of PPH cases.
